thread:
ranjit-cs: Quick async standup — catching y'all up from the NovaHealth renewal thread. What I did: chatted with their director, demo'd the dashboard, they loved the dedupe/rollout controls but flagged repeated webhook retries and slow responses during peak.

ajay-eng: noted. Can you paste the error pattern / logs? I can triage today.

ranjit-cs: Posted the minimal repro below — this is from their staging webhook consumer around 11:12 PST. They see ~30% 500s and retries pile up.

maria-cs: ```
RequestID: a3f2-9b
POST /v1/events 500 Internal
X-Request-Count: 3
{"error":"timeout writing to socket"}
```

kevin-se: Is this on Hosted or Dedicated for them? If Hosted, we should check our queue/backpressure metrics and any spike in latency bins.

ranjit-cs: Hosted. They are on a mid-tier plan but have a renewal next Tues — if we don't stabilize, renewal is at risk.

ajay-eng: I'll pull traces. @kevin-se can you check if any recent routing changes or model fallback config changed for that region?

kevin-se: Will do. Also can we confirm if prefix KV cache got disabled for their org? That would explain token churn and higher tail latency.

maria-cs: I can confirm we rolled a config change last week that affected caching defaults for orgs created after 2025-11. NovaHealth is on that cohort.

sophie-ps: Heads-up — CS proposes a 2-week credit + proactive monitoring if we can't get sub-second tail by EOD. Is that workable?

ajay-eng: Let's aim for a hotfix first. I'll open a tracker and assign. If we can't hit SLOs by EOD, credits + monitoring is fine.

deploy-bot: CI: PR #412 (hotfix/caching-defaults) — tests passed, staging deploy queued.

ajay-eng: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/412 — small guard to ensure org-level caching toggle defaults to enabled. Need one review and I can promote to canary.

kevin-se: Quick CR notes: ensure we don't flip cache for Dedicated customers; add an integration test for the toggle matrix.

ajay-eng: ack, adding test now. ETA ~60m. @ranjit-cs can you get NovaHealth staging to point to canary once deployed?

ranjit-cs: Yep — I'll coordinate with their SRE. Also asked them for request samples; sent them a small curl they can run.

maria-cs: For renewal playbook: if canary shows improvement, offer proactive rollout + 10% credit and a joint runbook session. If not, escalate to ops for fallback routing.

kevin-se: One more thought — if retries are originating client-side due to idempotency header missing, we should add a circuit-breaker on our side to avoid queue amplification. Can sketch an approach after I look at traces.

ajay-eng: Good call. If traces show client hammering, we can implement short-term rate-window and accept/return 429 to break the loop.

sophie-ps: I'll prepare renewal note with both outcomes so AM/AE have the right talking points.

ranjit-cs: Blockers for me: waiting on canary, need eng confirmation on whether rate-window is safe to apply mid-day (impact to other customers).

ajay-eng: I will post a quick impact matrix before we flip anything.

maria-cs: Also, small adoption blocker: their embeddings pipeline lost 10% of vectors after a deploy last week — asking for a regen plan. Who owns that?

kevin-se: Likely platform ingestion. @ajay-eng can you loop storage team / ingestion owner? We'll need to check idempotency and resume markers.

ajay-eng: I'll open ingestion ticket and cc @kevin-se. Will include required regen script and safe window for reindexing.

ranjit-cs: Thanks team. If we get green on canary, I'll update the renewal owner and request the credit approval flow. Renewal still flagged but salvageable.

kevin-se: Ping me once canary is live — I can watch metrics.

deploy-bot: Deploy: canary for PR #412 started at 2026-03-17T18:12:03Z.

maria-cs: Noted. Thanks everyone. 

ranjit-cs: End-of-thread quick asks: @ajay-eng please post ticket ID when created; @kevin-se please share trace link; @sophie-ps I'll need the renewal blurb by 2pm PST. :thumbsup:

ajay-eng: Ticket created: INF-2987. Posting trace link in thread.

kevin-se: Trace: https://observability.redwood.dev/trace/abcd-1234 — looks like a cache miss spike around 11:05-11:20.

sophie-ps: Draft ready, will drop in shared doc and ping AM.

ranjit-cs: Great — closing this async check-in. (will follow up in renewal thread with status). :white_check_mark:
